description: Use this when the user wants a new QR code that is also a picture: a scannable code painted into art from a description, that opens a link. It starts the code and answers at once with its id while the picture is painted, which usually takes under a minute; then call get_qr_code with the id to wait for the image. Do not use it to look at, list or change codes that already exist. Each code counts against the user’s QRX allowance.

destination.description: The link scans open: an absolute http or https URL, e.g. https://example.com/menu.

prompt.description: What the picture should show, e.g. "a lighthouse on a cliff at sunset".

style.description: A style id from list_styles. Leave out for the default.

name: generate_qr_code
